description: MySRYear sponsor-level checks for Open Scholarships (CC BY 4.0) records. An Open Scholarships listing is a lead; it is shown to students only when a check here confirms the CURRENT cycle on the sponsor's own page. Records without a check stay stored as 'unconfirmed' and hidden. Keyed by Open Scholarships id.

statuses.open: Sponsor page states the current cycle is accepting applications; closing date confirmed.
statuses.upcoming: Sponsor page publishes the next window; opens later.
statuses.closed_early: Sponsor page says applications stopped before the published deadline.
statuses.conflicting: Sponsor page gives conflicting dates; needs human review (hidden).
statuses.unreachable: Sponsor page could not be read (hidden until checked).
statuses.duplicate: Covered by an equivalent MySRYear sponsor-verified entry (hidden to avoid duplicates).
